nodes.norm_label: uncollectible customer invoice receivables must be written off through an append-only, invoice-linked correction entry

nodes.label: Full invoice must contain core seller/buyer/date/number/content fields
nodes.norm_label: full invoice must contain core seller/buyer/date/number/content fields

nodes.label: Issued invoices must be stored immutably with sequential invoice numbers
nodes.norm_label: issued invoices must be stored immutably with sequential invoice numbers
nodes.rationale: Rentemester must only issue invoices after deterministic validation and must persist an immutable issued snapshot tied to a sequential invoice number; when the invoice currency is not DKK, the snapshot must include the chosen FX rate and DKK totals fixed at issue time.

nodes.label: Issued invoices cannot be modified
nodes.rationale: Corrections to issued invoices are handled via credit note and new invoice, not mutation.

nodes.label: Invoice payments must be traceably applied against issued invoices and bank transactions
nodes.norm_label: invoice payments must be traceably applied against issued invoices and bank transactions

nodes.norm_label: invoice preview must render the issued-invoice pdf without mutating the ledger

nodes.label: Emailing an invoice or reminder must be deterministic, idempotent, and recorded in an append-only send log
nodes.norm_label: emailing an invoice or reminder must be deterministic, idempotent, and recorded in an append-only send log
nodes.rationale: Rentemester may email an issued invoice or a payment reminder to the customer with the rendered PDF attached, but only deterministically and idempotently. The MIME message and its message-id must be fully derived from the content so an identical send collapses onto the existing append-only send-log row instead of silently re-transmitting. A send is recorded in the send log (recipient, document, message-id, timestamp) and audit-linked; a transport failure writes no success row. SMTP credentials and SMTP configuration stay outside core bookkeeping state — they are sourced from a config file or environment, never persisted to the ledger. The send must fail clearly on a missing customer email or missing SMTP config.

nodes.label: Destination attestation renewal
nodes.rationale: Plan, region, security or path changes trigger reassessment; annual check recommended.

nodes.label: EU/EEA data-at-rest attestation
nodes.rationale: Contractual physical residency is human evidence, not a desktop preference.

nodes.label: Backup restore capability
nodes.rationale: Restore is its own codified requirement.

nodes.label: Recognised IT-security presumption
nodes.rationale: Certification supports a rebuttable presumption that can fail after concrete evidence of insecurity.

nodes.label: Template human destination attestations
nodes.rationale: Requires contractual region evidence, independent provider explanation and certifications with signer.

nodes.label: Provider plan/security/path rechecks
nodes.rationale: Annual operational controls distinct from GDPR/jurisdiction, encryption and restore testing.

nodes.label: Archive creation and placement record
nodes.rationale: Create archive, transfer/sync and record backup ID/destination ID/actor kind separately.

nodes.label: Provider residency scope and exclusions
nodes.rationale: Template demands exact admin navigation, migration completion, covered services, cache/metadata/plan exclusions.

nodes.label: Backup-provider guide template
nodes.rationale: Placeholder guide requires exact plan/admin/client details and official references, not an attestation of any provider.

nodes.label: Non-related third party
nodes.rationale: An independent provider qualifies; the owner’s home NAS does not.

nodes.label: Weekly full backup
nodes.rationale: Documented BEK205 §4 requires transactions and documents at least weekly unless unchanged; manifest timestamps/hashes encode cadence.

nodes.label: Human-attested compliance guides
nodes.rationale: The program cannot know cloud location, SaaS plan or provider datacenter changes.

nodes.label: Deterministic compliance report
nodes.rationale: Same ledger and as-of inputs produce identical HTML; SHA-256 lets an auditor detect modifications.

nodes.label: Rule-to-provision mapping
nodes.rationale: Report groups rule IDs by category with legal citations.

nodes.label: Rule documentation synchronization
nodes.rationale: Rule YAML, enforcement point, both matrices and human guides must change together; new sources require legal registry/scope updates.

nodes.label: Verified restore and human backup governance
nodes.norm_label: verified restore and human backup governance
nodes.rationale: Weekly transaction/document backup, independent EU/EEA destination; manifest/hash verified before readable restore.

nodes.label: Law → rule → implementation → human guide
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional traceability exposes both legal origins and requirements for a system area.

nodes.label: DK-BOOKKEEPING-BACKUP-001
nodes.rationale: Hybrid weekly full backup of posted transactions/documents with timestamp/hash manifest.

nodes.label: Exact deterministic accrual allocation
nodes.rationale: Balanced parking entry apportioned across periods; final-period penny remainder preserves exact sum.

nodes.label: Locked-year class-B report and advisory tax basis
nodes.norm_label: locked-year class-b report and advisory tax basis
nodes.rationale: Complete master data and locked year produce limited-taxonomy iXBRL; uncertain tax adjustments need review; filing external.

nodes.label: Human-confirmed immediate asset writeoff
nodes.rationale: Linear depreciation preserves purchase links; immediate writeoff needs user decision and source-backed threshold.

nodes.label: Period-bound authority and SAF-T export
nodes.rationale: Deterministic machine-readable package uses manifest hashes and declares unsupported sections.

nodes.label: Lossless bank import and reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Original batch data and FX retained; running balance continuity is warning; matched/unmatched records exposed.

nodes.label: Idempotent append-only SMTP delivery log
nodes.rationale: Send records append-only; encrypted SMTP credentials are practice rather than standalone rule ID.

nodes.label: Content-addressed immutable documents
nodes.rationale: SHA256 and immutable originals preserve evidence while statutory exception receipts retain original/currency.

nodes.label: Validated immutable sequential invoice issuance
nodes.rationale: Fields/arithmetic/master-data are validated before issuance; numbered issued snapshots cannot change.

nodes.label: Append-only balanced journal
nodes.rationale: Entries balance, require relevant documents and corrections use traceable reversal instead of mutation.

nodes.label: Deterministic single-registration late-payment claims
nodes.rationale: Interest, reminder limits/spacing and fixed B2B compensation register and book only once.

nodes.label: Closed-period and future-date guards
nodes.rationale: Reject journal entries in closed accounting periods or future dates.

nodes.label: Append-only master data and historical snapshots
nodes.norm_label: append-only master data and historical snapshots
nodes.rationale: Resolve/materialize fields before issuance/intake so later customer/vendor changes cannot alter old evidence.

nodes.label: Public OIOUBL/PEPPOL handoff and idempotent submission
nodes.norm_label: public oioubl/peppol handoff and idempotent submission
nodes.rationale: Immutable EAN buyer snapshot and deterministic export; access point/certificate setup remains external human work.

nodes.label: Prevalidated recurring invoice template
nodes.rationale: Immutable specification has legal content basis; deterministic generation rule has no legal source.

nodes.label: Five-year retention bounds GDPR erasure
nodes.rationale: Fiscal-year end plus five years controls erase rejection and append-only tombstones; subject export remains available.

nodes.label: Traceable invoice settlement and corrections
nodes.rationale: Payments, credit notes, refunds and bad-debt writeoffs preserve invoice and bank linkage.

nodes.label: Code/hybrid/human enforcement classification
nodes.rationale: Separates machine-checkable invariants from human assertions rather than pretending code knows external facts.

nodes.label: DK-BOOKKEEPING-BACKUP-DEST-001
nodes.rationale: Human-signed three-condition destination assertion documented as a rule; differs from older master-guide wording.

nodes.label: GDPR-RETENTION-BOUNDED-ERASURE
nodes.rationale: Retention deadline determines lawful erase and rejection tombstones.

nodes.label: Internal agent/import/generation integrity rules
nodes.rationale: Runtime permissions, migration reconciliation and recurring generation have no direct law source.

nodes.label: Legal source IDs and scope registry
nodes.norm_label: legal source ids and scope registry
nodes.rationale: Machine registry plus scoped provisions feed regulatory coverage; source law dates are recorded citations, not freshly verified current law.

nodes.label: Legal rule enforcement matrix
nodes.rationale: Documents the nonregistered baseline; each obligation mapped to YAML, enforcement and human guide.

nodes.label: DK-BOOKKEEPING-RESTORE-001
nodes.rationale: Manifest and hashes verified before restoring readable dataset.

nodes.label: DK-BOOKKEEPING-RETENTION-001
nodes.rationale: retain_until = financial year end plus five years.

nodes.label: DK-BOOKKEEPING-BACKUP-KEY-ROTATE-001
nodes.rationale: Rotation must remain auditable and preserve verification of older backups.

nodes.label: hard_stop / warning / advisory severity
nodes.rationale: Blocking, report-only and best-practice levels have distinct operational meanings.

nodes.label: Provision text_hash maintenance
nodes.rationale: Rules bind provision references and hashes; matrix maintained manually in same change.

nodes.label: Legal amendment verification workflow
nodes.rationale: Register source/XML, read exact operative changes, match cited provisions and update hashes/matrix if affected.
